items.title: Comfort Systems (NYSE:FIX) Beats Expectations in Strong Q2 CY2026
items.summary: HVAC and electrical contractor Comfort Systems (NYSE:FIX) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 50.3% year on year to $3.27 billion. Its GAAP profit of $12.53 per share was 20.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
